name: King Neptune's Seafood Restaurant
description: Family-owned for 25 years, King Neptune's Seafood Restaurant is known for fresh Gulf seafood, friendly service, and recipes refined for decades. The kitchen focuses on timing and technique—hand-breading seafood to order, grilling to temperature, and finishing every plate hot and flavorful. Owner Al Sawyer has spent a lifetime honing culinary skills to showcase the delectable fruits of the Gulf. King Neptune's is particularly famous for Royal Red Shrimp, deep-water Gulf shrimp known for their naturally sweet, delicate flavor. The restaurant is family-friendly, welcoming everyone from kids to grandparents, and offers dine-in, takeout, and larger orders for gatherings. The Sawyers have taken home first place at the Food Show in New Orleans, beating out 500 competitors including renowned Chef Paul Prudhomme. King Neptune's has been featured on Bobby Flay's Food Nation, The Travel Channel's Travel Deep in the South, Southern Living magazine, and Travel USA.
